message: Introduce `wait_for_user_input` action to enable interactive agent workflows that pause for user clarification and resume with their input. --- [Slack Thread](https://browser-use.slack.com/archives/D092QUQD6KA/p1756064891885299?thread_ts=1756064891.885299&cid=D092QUQD6KA) --- ## Summary by cubic Adds a new wait_for_user_input action that pauses the agent to ask the user a question and resumes when input is provided. Enables interactive follow-up tasks without breaking existing flows. - New Features - Registered wait_for_user_input in Controller with WaitForUserInputAction(question) and metadata to signal waiting. - Agent detects waiting metadata, exits the run loop, and exposes is_waiting_for_user_input(). - add_new_task clears the waiting flag and resumes execution. - Updated all system prompts with usage guidance. - Updated example to demonstrate asking, collecting input, and resuming. - Added FOLLOW_UP_TASKS_IMPLEMENTATION.md. - Migration - No breaking changes. - To resume: check is_waiting_for_user_input(), collect the user’s reply, call add_new_task("User responded: ... Continue ..."), then run again.
